notes: v231 — PIP-FACE-DESIGN-V41 + PIP-DOUBLE-FACE (owner, Fri Oct 23, 2026 10:50–10:54 MDT, his screenshot + hand drawing): TWO faces floated at once over his home screen (the widget-style face top-centre AND a big dark rectangle mid-screen), and the rectangle was never his design: 'Sis is not a buble. I thought [it would be] a big green buble on the left and smaller red buble on its right bottom and a timer going on under it... With the load tracker.' Refinement 1 (his drawing): BIG GREEN bubble top-LEFT; SMALLER RED bubble to its RIGHT set LOWER (~4–5 o'clock, slightly overlapping); UNDER BOTH, one WIDE rounded PILL bar with the TIMER and the LOAD TRACKER. Refinement 2 (hard requirement): 'all the space between them are see through! Not on a card.' — the gaps between the bubbles and the bar are TRANSPARENT; only the bubbles and the bar are solid. THE SHAPE, BUILT IDENTICALLY ON BOTH FLOAT SURFACES: (1) NATIVE system PiP (PipFaceView redrawn): the view paints NOTHING but the cluster — big circle (GREEN_D_FRAC 0.50 of the float, top-left), red circle (RED_D_FRAC 0.30, centre at 38° below horizontal, slight overlap), navy pill bar under both (clock left; load tracker right = −1 RED circle, the count, +1 GREEN circle; the status/direction word as one small line INSIDE the bar). State colours follow the law: GREEN + pause glyph while working, YELLOW (241,196,15) + play glyph while paused, GREEN + play when ready, white stop square in the red bubble. PiP aspect stays 4:3 (his v227 shape); the cluster anchors top-left and the rest of the window is see-through. (2) WEB in-app face (#bubbleFace, the Back-dock + old-shell PiP face): same cluster markup (bubPlay.bub-main / bubStop.bub-stopb / bub-bar with bubClock + bubMinus/bubLoads/bubPlus + bubStatus as the in-bar line); the container and wrappers paint NOTHING and taps fall through the gaps (pointer-events:none on the container, auto on the shapes); the docked posture lost its card chrome (no fill, no border, no card shadow). Also fixed in the same face: paintBubble's colours were SWAPPED (green showed only when NOT running) — now bub-go while running/ready, bub-pause while paused; the CSS pause colour now uses the defined --yellow (the old rule named an undefined --amber, so the yellow never rendered); the correction pair is labelled −1/+1 (his law's own words) and coloured RED/GREEN outright. PIP-DOUBLE-FACE — exactly ONE float after the fix: (a) MainActivity.showPipFace now hides the app view (INVISIBLE) and makes the window background TRANSPARENT for the float's life (both restored in hidePipFace), so the in-window web face/page can never show through or stack behind the native cluster; (b) the web face STANDS DOWN in system PiP when the shell draws its own face (new ShiftTrack.shellDrawsBubble capability probe on the plugin's bubbleState method) — the per-second fact mirror (pushBubbleFace via paintBubble) still feeds the shell face, proven by harness A2; on shells too old to draw a face the web face still shows (A7); (c) the home-screen WIDGET stands down while the float is up: MainActivity.onPictureInPictureModeChanged flips TrackerWidget.setFloatActive; buildViews then renders a quiet brand-only tile (new res/layout/widget_tracker_down.xml — no timer, no loads, no buttons; a tap still opens the app); restores on PiP exit, in onDestroy, and on plugin load() if the flag went stale across a process death. The widget itself cannot be removed by the app (it is owner-placed) — standing down to the quiet tile is the strongest stand-down Android allows. NAMED CHOICES (design authority — minimal, his to overrule): NO separate pause bubble (his drawing names exactly two bubbles; pause rides the big bubble — it turns YELLOW with a play glyph, the one toggle, exactly like the PiP system actions resolve it); the pill bar spans the float's FULL width (window/dock width minus pads), not just the bubbles' combined span, so timer + count + the big correction pair fit at glanceable sizes; the status/direction word rides as a small second line INSIDE the bar (his 'small words' law — no words float outside the shapes); native bar ± are drawn glance markers — the real taps remain the system PiP actions (Android gives a float no other buttons), unchanged from v227; the web dock posture keeps its bottom-left anchor over the dashboard.
